title: 瑞银资管Jade Fu：AI还要拿，但别把鸡蛋放一个篮子！
speaker: Jade Fu

segments.en: So if you ask my conviction I would still say that it's stay long AI
segments.zh: 如果你问我的信念，我仍然会说做多AI

segments.en: but stay rotating within that as well and also build a portfolio that also has something else
segments.zh: 但也要在其中轮动，并构建一个还包含其他资产的组合

segments.en: So don't put all your eggs in one basket build that resilience in your portfolio so that you can withstand the volatility
segments.zh: 所以不要把所有鸡蛋放在一个篮子里，在组合中构建韧性，以抵御波动

segments.en: Because I think if anything that's more certain is the elevated volatility and persistent fours of macro noises is here to stay
segments.zh: 因为我认为更确定的是高波动和持续的宏观噪音将继续存在

segments.en: So on your two strategies. What is that something else? What is that?
segments.zh: 那么在你的两个策略中，那个其他资产是什么？

segments.en: Uncorrelated assets so the China allocation. What is that there and Asia allocation? What is that there?
segments.zh: 非相关资产，比如中国配置，那里有什么？亚洲配置又有什么？

segments.en: Right, so I think I can generalize. Because that's how we that goes to the heart of asset allocation and multi asset to be honest
segments.zh: 我想我可以概括一下，因为这触及资产配置和多资产的核心

segments.en: We need to diversify um and diversify doesn't mean geography alone doesn't give you the diversification
segments.zh: 我们需要分散，分散并不意味着仅靠地域就能给你分散化

segments.en: You need to make sure that you're actually getting different sources of return
segments.zh: 你需要确保真正获得不同的收益来源

segments.en: So to put it back to the funds that we manage in Asia
segments.zh: 回到我们在亚洲管理的产品

segments.en: We are participating or engaging in the AI game still on one hand and that means selected
segments.zh: 我们一方面仍在参与AI领域，这意味着精选

segments.en: AI infrastructure and monetization beneficiaries on the other end we prefer to hold some high quality income
segments.zh: AI基础设施和商业化受益者，另一方面我们倾向于持有一些高质量收益资产

segments.en: That give you that resilience in volatile periods. I think one
segments.zh: 在波动时期给你韧性。我认为一个
